name: After § 15
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 15d. Recalls that Israel’s occupation of, and settlements in, East Jerusalem and the West Bank are also illegal under international law, and that Israel has already exceeded the one-year deadline it was given to dismantle them pursuant to the International Court of Justice Advisory Opinion of July 2024 and the subsequent UNGA Resolution A/RES/ES-10/24; calls on the Commission and the Member States to propose and implement sanctions against Israel;
